virtualTable.name: park-api_car_spots
virtualTable.sql: SELECT spot.id, spot.parking_site_id, spot.source_id, spot.original_uid, spot.name, NULL AS operator_name, spot.purpose :: text :: purposetype, 'spot' AS parking_object, spot.official_region_code, NULL AS public_url, NULL AS photo_url, NULL AS address, NULL AS opening_hours, NULL AS description, NULL AS has_lighting, NULL AS fee_description, NULL AS has_fee, NULL AS park_and_ride_type, spot.has_realtime_data, NULL AS realtime_opening_status, spot.realtime_status, spot.type :: text AS type, -- set capacity to 1 for all spots 1 AS capacity, NULL AS realtime_capacity, NULL AS realtime_free_capacity, pr.max_stay AS max_stay, -- Note: We assume that, for a spot, there is always at most one restriction (of any type). ( CASE WHEN pr.type = 'DISABLED' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS capacity_disabled, NULL AS realtime_capacity_disabled, NULL AS realtime_free_capacity_disabled, ( CASE WHEN pr.type = 'WOMEN' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS capacity_women, NULL AS realtime_capacity_women, NULL AS realtime_free_capacity_women, ( CASE WHEN pr.type = 'FAMILY' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS capacity_family, NULL AS realtime_capacity_family, NULL AS realtime_free_capacity_family, ( CASE WHEN pr.type = 'CHARGING' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS capacity_charging, NULL AS realtime_capacity_charging, NULL AS realtime_free_capacity_charging, ( CASE WHEN pr.type = 'CARSHARING' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS capacity_carsharing, NULL AS realtime_capacity_carsharing, NULL AS realtime_free_capacity_carsharing, ( CASE WHEN pr.type = 'RESIDENT' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS capacity_resident, NULL AS realtime_capacity_resident, NULL AS realtime_free_capacity_resident, ( CASE WHEN pr.type = 'BUS' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS capacity_bus, NULL AS realtime_capacity_bus, NULL AS realtime_free_capacity_bus, ( CASE WHEN pr.type = 'TRUCK' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS capacity_truck, NULL AS realtime_capacity_truck, NULL AS realtime_free_capacity_truck, ( CASE WHEN pr.type = 'CARAVAN' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS capacity_caravan, NULL AS realtime_capacity_caravan, NULL AS realtime_free_capacity_caravan, NULL AS max_height, NULL AS is_covered, NULL AS supervision_type, NULL AS related_location, ( spot.realtime_data_updated_at < now() - interval '30 minutes' ) AS realtime_data_outdated, NULL AS side, NULL AS orientation, NULL AS parking_type, spot.created_at, spot.modified_at, spot.static_data_updated_at, spot.realtime_data_updated_at, GeometryType(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(geojson), 4326)) AS geojson, spot.geometry FROM parking_spot spot LEFT JOIN parking_restriction pr ON spot.id = pr.parking_spot_id WHERE spot.purpose = 'CAR'
